title: AAC Observation Input 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Observation Input schema and its serialized data contract.

InvocationId.description: Stable identifier of this capability invocation.

ParentInvocationId.description: Identifier of the parent invocation when this invocation is nested.

Phase.description: Specifies the phase for this AAC observation input.

ProviderInstanceId.description: Stable identifier of the provider instance associated with this AAC observation input.

Arguments.description: Canonical operation arguments supplied to the provider.

Outcome.description: Final or observed outcome of the invocation.

Result.description: Operation result payload observed for the invocation.

Error.description: Structured failure information observed for the invocation.

Metadata.description: Additional structured metadata associated with this AAC observation input.
